content.rendered:
Have a great Thanksgiving.  We are thankful for all of our families and appreciate you for making our school a great place to be. We hope you all enjoy a wonderful week off from school doing whatever makes you happy.  We will see you back here on Monday, November 28th.

You can read our latest Middleton Weekly update HERE.
